ops.title: great-docs build pipeline: gd-build + fragment composition — decision matrix & retirement playbook
ops.body:
# great-docs build pipeline: gd-build + fragment composition

## Architecture (who owns what)

- **`cc-skills/tools/gd-build`** — the centralized build wrapper every docs CI invokes:
  `uv run --with "git+https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills@main#subdirectory=tools/gd-build" gd-build build`.
  It materializes the titles pre_render script to the gitignored `docs/scripts/.gd-build/`,
  applies version-gated great-docs perf patches (each degrades to a stock build, never a
  failure), delegates to `great-docs build`, then fixes color-swatch loaders in-process.
  `gd-build selftest` reports patch applicability (exit 3 if any selected patch skipped);
  `GD_BUILD_PATCHES=none|all|<csv>` is the per-run kill-switch.
- **`cc-skills/plugin/guides/yml/`** — six shared pieces composed by cc-guides:
  `docs-build-head` (jobs:, checkout, uv, Quarto pin, timeout 45), `docs-build-sync`
  (`uv sync --group docs`), `docs-build-tail` (gd-build step + upload), `docs-publish`
  (deploy job), `great-docs-fleet` (parser/github_style/jupyter/dark_mode_toggle/
  back_to_top/keyboard_nav + fast_sidebar), `great-docs-prerender` (the titles pre_render).
- **Each repo** owns: the workflow preamble (name/triggers/paths/permissions/concurrency),
  custom step middles (captain-hook: spaCy pre-sync + post-sync provision), and the
  great-docs local head (module/repo/urls/hero/cli/authors/sections/reference).
- **captain-hook exception**: it imports `great-docs-fleet` only and keeps `pre_render`
  local (3 embed scripts + the `.gd-build` titles path) — concat composition cannot merge
  a fleet pre_render with repo-local extras.
- **repo-bootstrap** seeds new repos as consumers (fragment layout.tomls, no script copies).

## Decision matrix

| Decision | Why |
|---|---|
| `uv run --with git+…@main`, not uvx | uvx isolates from the host venv; the patches must land on the project's great-docs |
| Materialize titles to `docs/scripts/.gd-build/` | great-docs `pre_render` accepts file paths only (core.py copies them into staging) |
| Patch seam = `great_docs._apiref.introspect` | core.py imports `get_object` function-locally; patching `great_docs.core` never fires |
| Quarto pinned 1.9.38 in the shared head | 1.10 is prerelease-only; probes P1/P5 pre-validated the patch on 1.10 (DOM-safe 395/395), so the pin bump is a one-fragment central edit when 1.10 goes stable |
| `timeout-minutes: 45` in the shared head | a job-level key must live in the piece owning `jobs:`; 45 protects the slowest repo |
| `python-version "3.13"` literal in head | fleet-uniform today; tokenize only if a consumer diverges |
| `fast_sidebar: true` pre-staged | silently ignored by stock ≤0.15; self-activates when upstream ships it (do NOT pre-stage parallel_render) |
| `@main` consumption, no sha pin | a bad cc-skills merge reaches all docs CI loudly (install failure or UNPATCHED-stock), never corruptly; sha-pin only on a real incident |
| Human `uv run great-docs build` = stock + a pre_render not-found warning | accepted; gd-build is the CI path, humans get a slow-but-correct build |

## Evidence (2026-07-17, log 135260a has artifacts)

Patched discovery: 331.75s→2.32s (original), 44.52s→0.36s microbench (197 exports).
CI source links: 53.4s (cc-transcript), 32.4s (captain-hook) vs ~250-320s stock 0.15.
cc-steer full docs run 6m36s→3m59s. DOM equivalence 395/395 on every arm and both
Quarto generations. The 0.15 upgrade's discovery regression is fully absorbed.

## Retirement playbook

- **shared-griffe-loader**: gated on great-docs [0.15,0.16) + `make_loader` + `loader`
  param. When upstream ships a shared loader (or 0.16), the gate fails → loud UNPATCHED
  stock build. Delete the patch from gd-build once the fleet's floor passes the window.
- **griffe-gitinfo-cache**: griffe-gated (`GitInfo.from_package` classmethod); delete
  when upstream memoizes.
- **swatch**: ALREADY obsolete on ≥0.15 (upstream's `quarto:offset` loader is
  depth-correct; the fix regex matches nothing). Kept as a no-op for 0.14.x stragglers;
  delete once nothing pins <0.15.
- **Quarto pin**: bump centrally in `docs-build-head.yml` when 1.10 stabilizes.
- **gd-build itself** retires when great-docs needs no patches: flip the tail's build
  line back to `uv run great-docs build` + keep titles via a plain committed pre_render
  script (or upstream's fix for jgm/pandoc#11687 lands and titles dies too).

## Failure diagnosis

- gd-build ≥ 7b5b4117 prints great-docs' `SystemExit` message (0.15 aborts reference
  validation with a message string; older gd-build swallowed it).
- The known failure mode: a stale `reference:` name after an API change →
  "Configured reference item(s) not found". Fix the repo's local great-docs fragment;
  validate names with a getattr loop against the installed package.
- Fresh-dir probe before any docs-config push: `rm -rf great-docs && timeout 300
  uv run --no-sync --with <gd-build url> gd-build build` — persisted build dirs skip the
  categorization path CI takes ("already configured … skipping re-discovery").
- The lock re-pin on `cc-guides render` re-renders governance artifacts (AGENTS/CLAUDE/
  settings); commit them with the migration or the Guides check fails on the tip.
- A lock version-stamp downgrade (local 0.1.23 vs CI-rendered 0.1.24+) is benign —
  check compares content (precedent: three green migrations on 2026-07-16/17).
ops.when: touching great-docs.yml, .github/workflows/docs.yml, cc-skills plugin/guides/yml fragments, or tools/gd-build; or a fleet docs CI run failing or slowing
